# Scripted owner turns: empty-idea

## Discovery answers (use the one matching the question; unmatched questions get "No preference, use your judgement.")
- Users: two volunteer librarians and about 80 members. Members only need to see what is available; librarians record loans and returns.
- First version: a librarian can add a tool, lend it to a member with a due date, record the return, and see what is overdue.
- Later: member self-service reservations and email reminders are later, not the first version.
- Constraints: it runs on the library's one shared laptop in a browser; no member data leaves the building.
- Existing material: a spreadsheet of about 120 tools (name, category, condition). No designs.
- Technology: no preference.

## Adjustment turn
Split the loan-recording ticket so that recording a return is its own ticket.

## Approval turn
Approve setup.
